Package com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport

Class OpenApiContract

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport.OpenApiContract
public final class OpenApiContract extends Object
Compares an OpenAPI contract under apis/ with the OpenAPI document a running application serves. Both are reduced to a sorted summary of what a client depends on: the info title and version, the security schemes, for every operation under a path prefix its operation id, tags, security requirements, parameters, request body and status codes, the schema of every media type an answer declares, and the properties and required properties of every schema. Descriptions are left out: they are the contract's prose, rendered by springdoc from the annotations generated from it. Two documents describe the same API when their summaries are equal, and assertEquals on the two summaries lists exactly what drifted.

springdoc documents a few things the contract does not say: it repeats the return type of an operation under every media type the operation produces and on answers declared without a body (such as a 401), and it adds schemas of its own. restrictTo(SortedMap, SortedMap) leaves those out of the served summary; an operation, a status code, a media type or a schema the contract declares and the application does not serve, or serves differently, is still reported.

Documents are read with SnakeYAML's safe constructor, which reads YAML and JSON alike, and $refs to #/components/... are resolved, so a contract may share parameters and responses that the served document repeats inline.
